base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.XCL_001 IN (c.XCL_007, c.XCL_008)
WHERE c.XCL_009 = 'TR001_3_4';
